# Mindless Rage (`features:berserker-mindless-rage`)
**Class:** [Barbarian](../classes/barbarian.md) | **Subclass:** [Path of the Berserker](../subclasses/path-of-the-berserker.md) | **Level:** [Barbarian 6](../levels/barbarian-6.md)

You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.
